tools.name: search_incidents
tools.description: Search published dossiers. Filters are combined. Returns short summaries with URL and citation.

tools.name: get_incident
tools.description: Full dossier: evidence states with supporting sources, drone types as named by sources, timeline, editorial history and citation.

tools.name: get_trends
tools.description: Dossiers per period (today, 7, 30, 90, 365 days) by incident date, with the previous period of the same length. Reflects archive coverage, not all incidents worldwide.

tools.name: list_drone_types
tools.description: Catalogue of drone types with category, origin, operators and published unit-cost estimates (third-party figures with source, year and price basis).

tools.name: get_drone_type
tools.description: Manufacturer, production, operators, unit-cost estimates with sources, characteristics.

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Evidence states, attribution rules, source families and how to cite.
